reason: I have never heard of PetMetro and nothing at the booth tells me what is actually in the pouch or whether it is right for a kitten. I only feed what the vet or the pet shop told me to, and I am not going to experiment on my first cat with a brand that is cheaper than what I buy now.
objection: Is it safe and complete for a kitten? It says 'no pork ingredients' and shows cartoon cats, but I see no ingredient list, no meat percentage, no 'complete food for kittens' statement, and no vet behind it. At RM 2.80 I wonder what the jelly is mostly made of.
would_change_my_mind: If my own vet or the pet shop I already use told me it is fine for kittens, and I could read the full ingredient list on the pack and see real meat first, I would buy a few pouches to try.
